_comment: Pinned SG13G2 PDK revision this sim/ tree's committed evidence records were generated against. Every record under sim/*/records/*.md must trace to this file (or a later commit that bumps it) -- see sim/README.md 'PDK pin' section. Not consumed by tooling; kept as a plain, greppable fact sheet. Follows sg13g2-bandgap/sim/pdk.json's shape (same PDK, same pinned release).
pdk_root_layout: PDK_ROOT/ihp-sg13g2 (open_pdks-shaped install, klt pdk find/list convention)

osdi_toolchain._comment: Provenance of the OSDI (Verilog-A compact model) binaries every MOS-instantiating testbench in this tree loads. sim/tools/build-osdi.sh is the executable source of truth (copied structurally from sg13g2-bandgap/sim/tools/build-osdi.sh, adjusted only for this repo's cache directory name); this block restates its pins as a greppable fact sheet.
osdi_toolchain.approach: source-compile the PDK's own Verilog-A models with a checksum-pinned prebuilt OpenVAF-Reloaded compiler
osdi_toolchain.install_dir: PDK_ROOT/ihp-sg13g2/libs.tech/ngspice/osdi (PDK-install territory, not tracked in this repo)
osdi_toolchain.note: All four are loaded by every testbench in this tree per the shared build-osdi.sh --check convention, even though sim/gm-id-characterization/ only instantiates sg13_lv_nmos/sg13_lv_pmos (PSP103.6, psp103.osdi) -- no resistor (r3_cmc) or bipolar device appears in this study.
